text:
Predicates:
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
LoanedOutTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to club y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for club y.
Club(x) ::: x is a football club.
Premises:
BornIn(ailtonSilva, 1995) ∧ KnownAs(ailtonSilva, Ailton) ∧ FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton.
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ LoanedOutTo(ailtonSilva, Braga) ::: Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga.
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, Nautico) ∧ PlaysFor(nautico, Nautico) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico. Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
Club(fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, fluminense) ::: Ailton Silva played for Fluminense.
